select POLICEMANGUID, LOGINID, PRISONID, USERID from SYS_USER where USERID = #{userid} and sfsc =0 and sfsy =1

SELECT distinct SM.GUID as guid, SM.menupid as menupid,SM.MENUNAME as menuname,SM.PATH as path, SM.OPENTYPE as opentype,SM.IMGPATH as imgpath,SM.BGCOLOR as bgcolor,SM.SORT as sort,nvl2(des.userid,1,0) as sfxz FROM SYS_MENU sm INNER JOIN SYS_ROLE_MENU srm ON SM.GUID = SRM.MENUGUID INNER JOIN SYS_ROLE sr ON SR.GUID = SRM.ROLEGUID INNER JOIN SYS_USER_ROLE sur ON SUR.ROLEGUID = SR.GUID INNER JOIN SYS_USER su ON SU.USERID = SUR.USERID left join sys_menu_desktop des on des.userid = su.userid and des.menuguid = sm.guid WHERE SU.USERID= #{userid} AND SU.IFUSE=1 and SM.IFUSE =1 and SM.DELETED =0 ORDER BY SM.SORT

select a.MENUPID as menupid, a.OPENTYPE as opentype, a.SORT as sort, a.IMGPATH as imgpath, a.GUID as guid, a.MENUNAME as menuname, a.PATH as path, a.BGCOLOR as bgcolor,a.IFUSE as ifuse ,NVL(b.MENUNAME, '') as menupname from SYS_MENU a left join SYS_MENU b on a.MENUPID = b.GUID left join SYS_MENU_DESKTOP c on a.guid =c.MENUGUID where a.DELETED =0 and a.IFUSE = 1 and c.USERID = #{userid} order by a.sort
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_loginlogs(studenterid, devicecode,deviceType,loginType) values ((select studenterid from common_student_user where studentuserid =(select guid from sys_user where loginid=#{loginId} and deleted=0 and ifuse= 1) and deleted=0 order by createdt limit 1),#{uniquecode},#{logincode},1);

INSERT INTO sys_user_loginlogs(studenterid, devicecode,deviceType,loginType) values ((select parenterId from common_parent_user where parentUserId = (select guid from sys_user where loginid=#{loginId} and deleted=0 and ifuse= 1) and deleted=0 order by createdt limit 1),#{uniquecode},#{logincode},3);
mapper.update: update common_student_user set uniquecode=#{uniquecode},updatedt=now() where studenterid =(select studenterid from (select studenterid from common_student_user where studentuserid =(select guid from sys_user where loginid=#{loginId} and deleted=0 and ifuse= 1) and deleted=0 order by createdt limit 1) a)

update common_parent_user set uniquecode=#{uniquecode},updatedt=now() where parenterId =(select a.parenterId from (select parenterId from common_parent_user where parentUserId =(select guid from sys_user where loginid=#{loginId} and deleted=0 and ifuse= 1) and deleted=0 order by createdt limit 1) a)
